title: Roblox Game Dev
author: Veelgez
selftext:
Hey, I know this is a bit different, but I’ve developed quite a few games with and without AI in Roblox and Godot.  
I have around 20 high quality games that I haven’t released yet. I mainly wanted to use this post to show that Roblox is actually a great platform for developing games. Yes, we’re still talking about Roblox.  
I completely understand if you don’t like Roblox, but when it comes to game development and marketing, I think there’s a lot you can learn from it and apply to your own games.  
Give it a try.  
You can test my game here ❤️  
https://www.roblox.com/share?code=85b617ca9626be4dbb84a60373b198ce&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1790774684849
